messages:
sarah_cs: Heads-up — Belmont Labs onboarding: their batched doc-summarize + chat combo is showing a stubborn tail. p50 130ms, p95 ~430ms, p99 ~1.4s, avg tokens ~1.05k. Renewal check in 9 days and exec is worried about cost. Any conservative, low-risk ops we can propose as a quick pilot?

theo_ml: Two pragmatic levers: 1) try a conservative int8 quant profile on a compact model variant, 2) route long requests (>1k tokens) to the compact variant during a small canary. Also enable prefix/KV caching for repeated doc contexts — that often helps more than people expect.

dan_sre: I can provision a 5% canary pool and add a token-length routing rule. Need acceptance criteria (latency + quality) and a rollback window.

laura_success: Acceptance: p95 < 320ms OR token-cost per 1k -20% AND summary quality regression <=1.0% (ROUGE/sem-sim). Rollback immediate if error_rate >1% or client reports quality issues.

theo_ml: Canary plan (draft):

```yaml
canary_name: belmont-compact-int8-pilot
steps:
  - pct: 5
    model: redwood/compact-v2
    quant: int8_safe_B
    cache_prefix: true
    fallback: redwood/llm-standard
  - wait: 4h
  - pct: 25
metrics:
  - p95_latency
  - summary_quality_delta: "<=1.0%"
```

Routing rule suggestion (applies during pilot window):

{"route_policy":"token_length","threshold":1000,"destination":"belmont-compact-int8-pilot","fallback":"llm-standard"}

sarah_cs: Client contact: carmela@belmont.ai, available Wed 10am PT for a 20m sync. I will invite. Need a 1-page playbook that explains expected latency, cost delta, rollback steps, and sample before/after outputs.

dan_sre: Applying routing config now and provisioning 5% pool. I will attach tracing and a canary alert if p95 > 320ms or quality_delta > 1.0%.

ops-bot: Canary job "belmont-compact-int8-pilot" scheduled by dan_sre. Start epoch 5105562000. Monitoring hooks and alert thresholds attached. :rocket:

laura_success: On the enablement call we should capture the 5-10 prompts they care about most and a few edge cases (long multi-doc, citation-heavy). We'll add those to their eval set immediately so we can detect regressions quickly.

theo_ml: I'll prepare the one-pager + quick eval harness (includes sample diffs and auto-rollback rule) and post by EOD. Also will include guidance on when to prefer compact-v2 vs compact-hybrid for doc-heavy loads.

sarah_cs: Plan summary: 1) enablement call Wed 10am PT (invite sent), 2) dan provisioned 5% canary (ops-bot confirmed), 3) theo finalizes playbook + quality thresholds, 4) run pilot 72h, collect client examples and evals, 5) escalate to 25% only if p95 <320ms and quality_delta <=1.0%. I will update this thread after call. :thumbsup:
